messages:
leo: opened a tiny docs PR to refresh the hello-pod quickstart: simplify auth, add local dev CORS note, and a GitHub Actions deploy snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901

ana: thanks! quick ask — are we keeping the short-lived server-side exchange or moving to client-only ephemeral tokens for the demo?

leo: keeping server-side exchange as recommended for production, but added a `demo` path that uses ephemeral client tokens to make first-run faster. added a clear security callout.

pritha: CI linkcheck failed on the sample-app link (samples/hellopod -> moved to samples/hellopod-v2).

ci-bot: build failed 76 docs/linkcheck79 1 broken link: /samples/hellopod -> 404

leo: good catch, updated the sample link and also added a small note about pinning the sample commit SHA so tutorials don't drift.

sam: nit: the GH Actions snippet sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but our runtime examples use REDWOOD_KEY. can we standardize?

leo: switched all snippets in the quickstart to REDWOOD_KEY and added an envvar table explaining both legacy and new names for backcompat.

pritha: also added a short CORS troubleshooting box for local dev where `localhost:3000` hits the auth server. includes curl example to validate headers.

leo: included the curl block and a one-line `Docker` example showing `--build-arg NODE_ENV=production` like Jenny suggested in the other thread.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK now; docs/lint warnings: docs/quickstart-hellopod.md:line 45 sentence length.

sam: small editorial: change "secure by default" phrase to "secure configuration is recommended" we avoid policy wording.

leo: updated language. also added a 3-bullet migration checklist for teams upgrading from SDK v2 samples: env var rename, token exchange endpoint, and sample repo path changes.

pritha: could you add a tiny GH Action step to run `npm ci && npm run build` against the sample so we catch regressions on sample compatibility?

leo: good idea  added a minimal check step that runs in docs CI for PRs touching sample links. pushed commit and requested reviews.

ci-bot: build passed 76 docs/linkcheck + tests79; requesting approvals.

sam: approved :thumbsup:

pritha: approved, thanks for the extra migration notes.

leo: merging after green main CI to backport to release-2.x. follow-up: I'll open a separate tiny PR to update the samples repo README with the recommended envvar names.
